accepted_source_scope: Actual BPF instructions allow ordinary native syscalls, deny connect and INET/INET6 sockets, and reject x32/non-x86-64 while preserving AF_UNIX socketpair.
SIGCHLD is normalized; pidfd acquisition and durable spawn record precede gate release; post-fork errors retain supervision.
Direct/adopted deduplication, finite pass errors, authoritative ECHILD reconciliation, durable terminal-before-reap and slot retirement are source-coherent.
Child signals/descriptors are restored/closed before absolute execve and payload status propagates.
False acknowledgment is removed; unresolved ownership retains the live synchronous subreaper and handles.
next_scope: Prepare and independently review a bootstrap packet compiling only the exact owner translation unit with pinned GCC, headers/libc, warnings and a fresh disposable output.
limitations: Source-model tests are not native execution evidence.
Unidentified live adopted children may require indefinite retained supervision.
Blocking filesystem operations, owner SIGKILL/host failure and hostile same-UID interference are outside demonstrated guarantees.
Resource limits remain per-process and the filter is not a general hostile-code sandbox.
